lines.trans: Come with me into my office.
Chef, where are we going now?
We need a very serious conversation.
Did you hear everything in the kitchen?
I heard every word of yours.
I myself do not understand anything.
You caused a real big scandal.
I did not want to offend anyone.
Go into the room and close the door.
Good, I am already closing the door.
Sit on a chair and listen to me.
I am listening to you attentively, chef.
Now your life will change greatly.

examples.trans: I grew up in a communal flat.

meanings.note: at the start of a sentence
polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.trans: The door is behind the wardrobe.

meanings.note: a door, a shop, or a legal case

заходить.gloss: to come in, to drop in

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

meanings.note: to run for a second term

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: a person's own room at work
for movement; где is for location

examples.trans: Three rooms and a big kitchen.

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
needs 'не' with the verb: никто не войдёт

examples.trans: I know the town like nobody else.

meanings.note: usually in the genitive ничего, with не: ничего не осталось
short form 'нужен / нужна / нужно / нужны' + dative: 'мне нужна работа' = I need a job

meanings.en: to offend, to hurt someone's feelings

examples.trans: Sorry, I didn't mean to offend you.
He didn't want to offend anyone.
I love our town very much.

meanings.note: понимаешь? = you know? do you understand?

examples.trans: I want to go to the sea, you know?

examples.text: У нас с тобой серьёзный разговор.
examples.trans: You and I have a serious talk to have.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

examples.text: Я приехала к очень серьёзному человеку.
examples.trans: I have come to see a very important man.

meanings.en: to sit down, to take a seat

examples.trans: He sat down on a chair.
The wind is blowing hard outside.
A scandal began in the restaurant dining room.
There is no need to make a scene.

meanings.note: 'дать слово' = to give one's word, 'держать слово' = to keep one's word
the imperative 'слушай' starts a sentence, like 'look, ...'

examples.trans: Put the chair by the table.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

meanings.note: уже четыре года = for four years now

examples.text: Я уже четыре года работаю мэром.
examples.trans: I've been mayor for four years now.

meanings.en: to arrange, organize, set up an event or scheme

examples.text: Я всё устрою на высшем уровне.
examples.trans: I will arrange everything at the highest level.
They organized a party for friends.
If you don't want to, suit yourself.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)
